title: Long-Distance Movers in Long Beach | SOS Moving
metaDescription: Comparing the best long-distance moving companies in Long Beach? SOS offers a flat rate, a truck for your household only and a plan for curbs and condo rules.
heroSubtitle: Flat-rate interstate moves from Long Beach, loaded by one crew into a truck reserved for your household

faq.question: Who do I call to hold curb space for the moving truck in Long Beach?
faq.answer: Ask the city's Street Maintenance unit for a temporary No Parking or No Stopping zone for a moving van. The oversized-vehicle permit is not the right request for this. We will suggest which part of the block to reserve so the truck can stand close to your door.

faq.question: Can the truck load in the alley behind my house?
faq.answer: No. Long Beach does not allow parking in any alley, since alleys have to stay passable for fire trucks and ambulances. We load from the street, and the longer carry around the house is part of the flat rate.

faq.question: My HOA only gives Saturday move slots. Can you work then?
faq.answer: Yes. We work Monday through Sunday from 8AM to 6PM, so a Saturday assigned by an HOA fits our schedule; AQUA downtown, for one, allows Saturday moves but not Sunday ones. Book the building's slot first, then reserve the truck for that day.

faq.question: How is the price for a move from Long Beach to another state calculated?
faq.answer: It is a flat rate agreed before loading, not an hourly charge. We base it on your inventory, the route, how much packing our crew does and access at both homes, with fuel, mileage and taxes already inside it. Stairs, elevators and a long carry do not add to it.

faq.question: How long does delivery take after the truck leaves Long Beach?
faq.answer: That depends on the route. Our published ranges for a dedicated truck run from same-day delivery on trips up to 400 miles to 3–7 days on the longest cross-country runs, and your quote names your own window. We call before the truck arrives.

faq.question: Is there a deposit, and when is the rest paid?
faq.answer: A 5% deposit reserves the date. Then 60% of the balance is processed after loading, and the final payment waits until you confirm that everything was delivered.
